statement: This sketch creates an ethereal stained glass composition where geometric panels float across the canvas in a subtle gradient background. The structure pulses with dynamic light beams that trace the edges of each panel, shifting through the entire visible spectrum in rhythmic waves. These glowing highlights create an effect of light refracting and dancing across the intersecting lines, producing a mesmerizing halo that seems to breathe with life. The composition balances complexity with visual harmony, using hundreds of polygonal panels to build an intricate architectural pattern that feels both organic and structured.
